Hajong tśal and Bhatri cala/cal roof fit this family with source affricate and lateral notation retained. The elicited roof sense is broader than thatch, and local Indo-Aryan transmission remains open. This does not equate separate chad roof or cauni thatching forms with cāla. Exact response: tśal.
